title: Ready
description: plugin → companion. The harness can now ANSWER, which is not the same as the plugin being connected. A plugin attaches while its harness is still starting — Hermes connects its platform adapters before the gateway reaches `running`, and its own base adapter warns that an inbound message arriving before the message handler is installed is 'silently discarded on an adapter that still polls and sends'. So `hello` means 'I am here' and `ready` means 'send me work'. The companion HOLDS every ring until it arrives: a brief delivered into that window is answered by a harness that cannot answer, and the turn closes empty with the reply arriving seconds later, for a request that is already gone.

v.description: Protocol version. A shape change is a new version, never an edit of v1 in place.

harnessVersion.description: The harness's version, now that the plugin can read it. It is often unknown at hello time, because the harness is still starting.
